about: How Handovers is built, as a graph. Loaded into the FalkorDB graph handovers_project at backend startup (services/tech_graph.py) and shown by the 'How it's built' button. Edit this file when the architecture changes; the graph reloads itself when the file does.

components.name: Browser
components.summary: HR, IT, managers, leavers and successors. Holds only an httpOnly session cookie, never a token.

components.name: React app
components.summary: React 19, Vite and Tailwind. One app, a different home per role; every view is permission-scoped by the API.

components.name: Graph X-ray
components.summary: Shows the named Cypher queries behind each screen and the graph around its subject.

components.name: How it's built
components.summary: This view: the project's own architecture, read from FalkorDB.

components.name: Sign-in API
components.summary: Backend-for-Frontend: /login, /callback, /session, /logout; sign-in provider setup.

components.name: Handovers API
components.summary: Open a handover, analyse gaps, exit interview, approve and transfer.

components.name: People API
components.summary: People and their work memory, scoped to who is asking.

components.name: Readiness API
components.summary: What blocks the last day; account reassignment and backup owners.

components.name: Companion API
components.summary: The successor asks the leaver's memory questions.

components.name: Me, KPIs and copilot API
components.summary: Who am I, demo personas, KPIs and the search-bar copilot.

components.name: Uploads and review API
components.summary: Upload any document; approve or reject extracted facts.

components.name: Integrations API
components.summary: Connect platforms, test credentials, sync now. Platform admin only.

components.name: X-ray and project API
components.summary: Query traces, subgraphs, and this project graph.

components.name: Access rules
components.summary: Every permission rule in one place: roles plus relationships read from the graph.

components.name: Handover workflow
components.summary: Open, analyse, interview, approve, transfer. Knowledge is superseded, never deleted.

components.name: Read models
components.summary: Work memory, org risk and handover gaps.

components.name: Readiness
components.summary: What still blocks the last day, who owns it, and the next action.

components.name: Companion
components.summary: Answers from what the person's memory holds, with sources, or says it does not know.

components.name: Copilot
components.summary: The search bar: the app guide plus the caller's own memory.

components.name: Hiring outputs
components.summary: Job description, screening criteria, resume check and interview kit for the replacement, from the graph.

components.name: Policy
components.summary: Pure rules: gap weights, question templates, transfer rules. No I/O, unit-tested.

components.name: Connector sync
components.summary: Pull what changed since the last sync, extract facts, write through the review gate.

components.name: Identity
components.summary: Keeps Keycloak in step with the graph: people, and the sign-in providers.

components.name: Project graph loader
components.summary: Loads this architecture into FalkorDB and reads it back.

components.name: Ingestion pipeline
components.summary: Parse, extract into a closed ontology, resolve people, then write or queue for review.

components.name: Named query runner
components.summary: Runs catalogued, parameterised Cypher; reads use GRAPH.RO_QUERY; every call is traced.

components.name: LLM adapter
components.summary: Optional. Groq, Vertex or Anthropic; deterministic templates when off.

components.name: Keycloak client
components.summary: Authorization code with PKCE, token verification, and the admin API.

components.name: Security
components.summary: Fernet encryption for stored credentials; hashed session tokens.

components.name: Cypher catalogue
components.summary: Every query the app runs, one named .cypher file each, parameterised, never built from user input.

components.name: Graph schema
components.summary: Indexes and constraints applied at bootstrap.

components.name: Northwind sample company
components.summary: A synthetic company, loaded into an empty graph at startup.

components.name: FalkorDB: company graph
components.summary: The primary database. One graph per tenant (handovers__northwind): people, work, knowledge, handovers, sessions.

components.name: FalkorDB: project graph
components.summary: handovers_project: this architecture, so the app can explain itself.

components.name: Keycloak
components.summary: Open-source sign-in. Brokers Microsoft and Google, pinned to the organisation.

components.name: Connector registry
components.summary: One package per platform behind one contract: fields, check(), pull(). A work tool can have several accounts, each serving teams.

components.name: GitHub
components.summary: Commits, pull requests with reviewers, issues.

components.name: Slack
components.summary: Threads and substantial messages, by author.

components.name: Jira
components.summary: Issues by assignee.

components.name: Notion
components.summary: Runbooks, decision records and specs.

components.name: HubSpot and Salesforce
components.summary: Who owns which customer relationship and deal.

components.name: Entra ID directory
components.summary: People, titles, teams, managers and leavers from Microsoft Graph. Its tenant ID, client ID and secret also sign people in.

components.name: Google Workspace directory
components.summary: People, titles, teams, managers and leavers from the Admin SDK, via a service account. Its OAuth client also signs people in.

components.name: Sign-in providers
components.summary: One package per provider; each signs in with its directory card's values. Okta and Auth0 are planned.

components.name: Sign in with Microsoft
components.summary: Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) as an OpenID Connect provider in Keycloak, pinned to the organisation's tenant.

components.name: Sign in with Google
components.summary: Google Workspace through Keycloak's Google provider with hostedDomain: only the organisation's domain gets in.

components.name: Microsoft Entra ID
components.summary: Microsoft's identity service (formerly Azure AD): sign-in for the tenant, and Microsoft Graph for the directory.

components.name: Google Workspace
components.summary: Sign-in pinned to the domain; Admin SDK for the directory.

components.name: Work tools
components.summary: GitHub, Slack, Jira, Notion, HubSpot, Salesforce APIs.

components.name: LLM provider
components.summary: Optional, for extraction and answers.

components.name: Alerts API
components.summary: Alert settings, inbox, reminders, the daily digest, the platform admin's channels, and Meta's webhook.

components.name: Candidates API
components.summary: Candidates for a leaver's vacancy: import a job board's export, screen, alert.

components.name: Alerts
components.summary: Who hears about what, how and when: in-app inbox, WhatsApp, email, quiet hours, digest.

components.name: Alert channels
components.summary: WhatsApp and email set up by the platform admin: encrypted settings, Test, a master switch each.

components.name: Exit clearance
components.summary: No-dues: every account, piece of work and asset signed off before the relieving letter.

components.name: Candidates
components.summary: Screens a job board's candidates (WorkIndia export) against the role's criteria.

components.name: WhatsApp Cloud API
components.summary: Meta's API: alerts with reply buttons; replies come back through the webhook.

components.name: Email (SMTP)
components.summary: Any SMTP server; Mailpit catches every email in development.
